title: LungeFix
description: A small datapack that attempts to fix the newly added Lunge enchantment
body:
- **Reduces the lunge durability damage from**
  > 2^((`enchantment level`*2) + 1)

  to

  > 2^((`enchantment level`) + 1)
- **Removes the mending incompatibility**
- **Adds a very minor room for vertical push when using it**
  `(doesn't even push enough to lift you up from the ground and is mostly because I felt it made the push feel less rigid while in the air, but may be placebo)`
- **Enables its use while elytra flying, but it is severely weaker in this case**
